{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Structured black wool-blend blazer with a tailored fit, cropped length at the hip, #121212 charcoal gray color, fine-midweight woven fabric.
Cream silk blouse with a subtle sheen, relaxed collarless cut, midi length ending above the knee, ivory hue, lightweight crepe de Chine material.
High-waisted black tailored trousers in a slim straight leg, ankle-length hem just clearing the shoe, #000000 true black color, stretch wool-twill fabric.
Black leather ankle boots with a low 4 cm block heel, pointed toe shape, mid-calf shaft, smooth calfskin leather material.

This outfit works because it balances the energetic atmosphere of a rock concert with the requested classic register by using dark, structured silhouettes that stand out in artificial club lighting. The wool-blazer and tailored trousers provide necessary warmth for autumn evenings while maintaining a sleek profile suitable for standing in a crowd without feeling restricted. The cream blouse adds a touch of refined contrast to the all-black base, elevating the look from casual streetwear to the smart formality required for a sophisticated night out."}
